parsedVerdict.reasoning: This unit passes. All three files handle one concern: use-case services for the orders aggregate. Each injects OrdersRepository through its constructor and returns the domain Order model. The read services just pass calls through to the repository. UpdateOrderService routes state changes through the domain methods (order.changeStatus, order.addInfoToDescription) instead of setting fields directly, so it doesn't bypass the module's abstractions. There is no duplicated rule or invariant. UpdateOrderService calls findOrderByIdWithDeliveryman directly, as FindOneOrderService does, but that is one shared repository call, not a duplicated rule. Two correctness problems sit outside this cohesion rule but are worth noting. First, update-order.service.ts uses `??` where it should use `&&`, so the domain mutators never run. Second, it doesn't handle a null order.
